author: CBR
description:
Jaws did more than scare audiences in 1975. Steven Spielberg’s shark thriller helped create the modern summer blockbuster.

We break down why Jaws is often called the original summer blockbuster, how it turned a theatrical release into a full-blown movie event, and why Hollywood spent decades trying to copy its success. From audiences lining up around the block to the film crossing $100 million at the U.S. box office, Jaws changed what studios thought a summer movie could be.
